nextItems: Now: a confirmation email with all your booking details.
A few days before: a WhatsApp message from us about your arrival.
On arrival: tell us your arrival time in advance and the family will welcome you. At Theodora, there's cold water waiting in the fridge.
Scheduled cruises: 20% off. Just give your name at the kiosk in front of Aegealis.
